messages:
olivia: hi y'all, Olivia here - first day! Followed the guide but my kubeconfig only shows `local` and `ci`. I don't see `redwood-dev` and I can't access `team-olivia`. Who handles RBAC?
tom-infra: welcome Olivia :wave: Typically infra handles the RoleBinding. Quick checks: paste `kubectl config get-contexts` and confirm cloud login (aws sso login --profile redwood or gcloud).
olivia: pasted `kubectl config get-contexts` -> shows `local` and `ci`. I ran aws sso login but forgot the eks update step. Ran `aws eks update-kubeconfig --name redwood-dev --region us-west-2 --alias redwood-dev` now I see the context but `kubectl get pods -n team-olivia` -> Error from server (Forbidden): pods is forbidden.
kube-bot: created ticket ONB-901 for olivia requesting namespace RoleBinding. Assigned to tom-infra.
tom-infra: you're not in group `redwood-developers` yet. I can create RoleBinding `rb-olivia-onboard` in `team-olivia` binding your SSO email to `edit` for first-week access. Confirm SSO email?
olivia: olivia@redwood.ai
tom-infra: done — RoleBinding `rb-olivia-onboard` created. Wait ~30s then run `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n team-olivia` and `kubectl get pods -n team-olivia`. If you see cached token errors, run `aws sso login` again.
devx: FYI to set default namespace on the context: `kubectl config set-context redwood-dev --namespace=team-olivia` or `kubectl config set-context --current --namespace=team-olivia`. Saves using `-n`.
sara-security: secrets access is separate. Open a secrets ticket with justification and TTL if you need it. We grant short-lived `secrets-get` for dev.
olivia: `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n team-olivia` -> yes. `kubectl get pods -n team-olivia` -> No resources found. Set context default namespace; all good now, thanks everyone :smile:`
